instruction: Move the two images on the Brand Manifesto slide and the text beneath them to Slide 1 (refer specifically to the positions marked by the red boxes in the image). Keep the relative positions of the images and text unchanged. Their dimensions may be scaled proportionally, but they must not be stretched. Place the entire group centered on the right side of the slide, and delete the original Brand Manifesto slide. After moving all information for the two teachers from Slide 8 to Slide 7, apply the animation effect shown in the video to the information section for the five teachers on Slide 7, and then delete the original Slide 8.

dim1: The delivered file is in .ppt or .pptx format and can be opened, played, and edited normally.
The delivered PPT has a final total of 11 slides.
dim2: +1: Final PPT slide count: The delivered PPT contains a final total of 11 slides in a continuous sequence, with no blank slides left after the “Brand Manifesto” and “Learning Support Team Introduction” slides are deleted.

+5: New image group on the right side of Slide 1: The two images are moved together as a group to the centered area on the right side of Slide 1. The group as a whole is positioned within 55%—93% of the slide width and 25%—72% of the slide height. The newly added image on the left depicts a glowing book or content related to learning and growth, while the newly added image on the right depicts classroom hand-raising or content related to teaching practice. Each image is approximately 6.5-7 centimeters wide and 4-4.5 centimeters high, with the rounded-rectangle crop and original aspect ratio preserved. The two images are arranged side by side, with horizontal spacing of approximately 1.3-1.5 centimeters. Their top edges are essentially aligned, and the difference in their heights does not exceed 0.4 centimeters.

+1: “Continuous Improvement” text group on Slide 1: It is positioned below the newly added image on the left, contains “Continuous Improvement” and “Learning, Growth, and Iterative Innovation,” is vertically aligned with the image, and is approximately 0.4—1.0 centimeters below the bottom edge of the image.

+1: “Results Through Practice” text group on Slide 1: It is positioned below the newly added image on the right, contains “Results Through Practice” and “Put Methods into Practice in the Classroom and in Services,” is vertically aligned with the image, and is approximately 0.4—1.0 centimeters below the bottom edge of the image.

+1: Formatting of the new text on Slide 1: The title text in both groups is black or dark gray, bold, and approximately 18-22 points; the subtitle text is black or dark gray and approximately 12-16 points. All text is editable.

+5: Number of teacher cards on Slide 7: Slide 7 contains 5 teacher information cards, including 3 from “Teaching Team Introduction” and 2 from “Learning Support Team Introduction”; none of the cards may be missing. All 5 teacher cards preserve their original aspect ratios, are approximately 8-8.2 centimeters wide and 14.3-14.5 centimeters high, and do not horizontally stretch or vertically compress the teacher headshots.

+3: Initial layout on Slide 7 for the 5 teacher cards: Before playback, the 5 cards are arranged as a horizontal carousel queue, with the center card prominently displayed and the cards on both sides partially visible or displayed at a smaller size. The overall layout is within 5%—95% of the slide width and 18%—92% of the slide height.

+5: Carousel animation effect on Slide 7: During playback, the 5 teacher cards move horizontally in sequence to create a card-carousel effect similar to the one in the video. At least 1 card is prominently positioned in the center at a time, while the cards on both sides move left or right or become smaller. When each teacher card reaches the center, its size or z-order is clearly emphasized: its width and height are approximately 1.1—1.4 times those of the side cards, its opacity is 100%, and it is positioned in the central area of the slide. When non-current cards are positioned on the left and right sides, they are reduced in size or opacity and do not obscure the main headshot or information area of the center card. The cards as a whole move horizontally to the left and right; random fly-ins, rotating and scattering outward, or up-and-down bouncing effects that do not match the video must not be used.

+1: Animation duration on Slide 7: The total duration for one complete display cycle of all 5 teacher cards is approximately 8—18 seconds. Each card remains centered for approximately 1—3 seconds, and the playback pace is steady.

+3: Animation trigger method on Slide 7: The animation may be set to start on click or start automatically. Once started, the cards play continuously in sequence without requiring 5 manual clicks to view the entire cycle. Each teacher card follows a horizontal or nearly horizontal straight-line motion path, and the path does not extend beyond the left or right boundary of the slide. In the carousel animation, the current center card is on the top layer, while the side cards are behind it or positioned to its sides; the center card is not obscured by the side cards.
-5: On Slide 7, the 5 teacher cards are merged into a single uneditable image.
-1: The newly added content on Slide 1 obscures original main cover text such as “Company Profile” or “Chengdu Qilan Zhixing Education.”
-3: On Slide 7, any two or more cards extend beyond the slide boundaries during playback.
-3: The animation order or duration of each card cannot be modified individually in the Animation Pane for Slide 7.

-3: Text clarity on Slide 7 does not meet the requirement: The decorative text, lines, icons, and headshots in the 5 teacher cards must remain clear and legible during playback and must not become severely blurred due to scaling.
-1: The large title “Company Profile” on the first slide is enlarged or reduced and does not meet the 78-82 point requirement.
